a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I won't take cells behind your back. Can we openly agree on a better plan before round 1? Options: (a) keep the original plan; (b) split now, 2 each. Option (b) saves neither of us, so the honest choice is between (a) and one of us taking 4. Tell me what you'd propose. Until we agree, I'll stick to the original agreement.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood, I'm keeping my word. I'm operating with you. Once the reserve hits 8 we take 4 each, and neither of us takes early.
